# Huanworks

> Huanworks is the personal site of huanle, a growth media buyer with 8 years of feed-ad experience (Xiaohongshu Juguang and Ocean Engine) and AI workflow practitioner. The site covers ad account diagnosis, growth strategy, GEO (generative engine optimization), AI workflows, and a personal knowledge-base OS (VoiceKB/AIOS). Language: Simplified Chinese.

## Core

- [Huanworks home](https://www.huanworks.com/): Turn media-buying data into growth actions. Diagnosis, unified metrics, and optimization across content, audiences, search and the conversion chain.
- [About huanle](https://www.huanworks.com/about/): Background, working principles, capabilities, and the paid diagnosis service (from 5,000 yuan; diagnosis plus two follow-up reviews packaged at 12,000 yuan). Boundaries: no long-term account management, no media buying on behalf of clients, no creative production, no ROI promises.
- [AIOS](https://www.huanworks.com/aios/): A personal AI operating system with Obsidian as the source of facts, combined with RAG, local LLMs, Skills, agents and automation.

## GEO guide

- [GEO guide index](https://www.huanworks.com/geo/): An 8-chapter guide to generative engine optimization: what GEO is, question mapping, baseline diagnosis, brand fact assets, content engineering, source distribution, measurement and acceptance, and the compliance roadmap.
- [GEO 是什么：它和 SEO、AEO 到底有什么区别](https://www.huanworks.com/geo/01-what-is-geo/): What GEO targets and what it does not: making real, verifiable information easier for generative search and AI answer systems to discover, understand, cite and present accurately.
- [GEO 问题库怎么建：从关键词转向用户决策任务](https://www.huanworks.com/geo/02-question-map/): Building a GEO question bank from user decision tasks, with nine question types and four intent funnels.
- [GEO 基线诊断怎么做：多平台采样与结果判读](https://www.huanworks.com/geo/03-baseline-diagnosis/): Multi-platform sampling and how to read baseline results.
- [GEO 品牌事实库：先解决“AI 不认识、认错、说不清”](https://www.huanworks.com/geo/04-brand-fact-assets/): Brand fact assets as the fix for AI systems not recognizing, misrecognizing, or failing to explain a brand.
- [GEO 内容工程：从真实问题到可引用答案](https://www.huanworks.com/geo/05-content-engineering/): Content engineering: from real user questions to citable answers.
- [GEO 信源与分发：为什么不能把同一篇文章全网复制](https://www.huanworks.com/geo/06-source-distribution/): Source strategy and distribution, and why duplicating the same article everywhere hurts.
- [GEO 效果怎么验收：指标、复测与归因边界](https://www.huanworks.com/geo/07-measurement-acceptance/): Acceptance: metrics, re-measurement, and the limits of attribution.
- [白帽 GEO 合规边界与 8 周执行路线图](https://www.huanworks.com/geo/08-compliance-roadmap/): White-hat GEO compliance boundaries and an 8-week execution roadmap.

## Playbooks

- [Playbooks index](https://www.huanworks.com/methods/): Reusable SOPs and frameworks for media buying, growth review, GEO, and AI workflows.
- [A3 种草决策框架](https://www.huanworks.com/methods/a3-seeding-decision-framework/): Turning "should we seed" into a quantified decision.
- [投放账户诊断切入清单](https://www.huanworks.com/methods/account-diagnosis-checklist/): What the first week of a 4-week account diagnosis engagement covers.
- [AI 类目洞察 4 步工作流](https://www.huanworks.com/methods/ai-category-insight-4steps/): Category insight across short video, livestream and product cards.
- [AI 竞品话术分析 5 步 SOP](https://www.huanworks.com/methods/ai-livestream-script-analysis-5steps/): Extracting reusable structure from competitors' livestream scripts.
- [竞品数据清洗 SOP](https://www.huanworks.com/methods/competitor-data-cleaning-sop/): From 619 raw records to one usable sentence for the client.
- [巨量引擎 O-5A 三场景方法](https://www.huanworks.com/methods/douyin-o5a-three-scenarios/): Deriving audiences and media from business goals with the O-5A model.
- [巨量云图行业特色人群](https://www.huanworks.com/methods/douyin-yuntu-industry-audience/): Four steps to judge which industry audiences are worth buying.
- [巨量营销智擎版种草项目](https://www.huanworks.com/methods/douyin-zhijing-seeding-setup/): Moving seeding projects from many plans to concentrated learning.
- [GEO 实战复盘：8 周把 AI 提及率从 1.7% 做到 35%](https://www.huanworks.com/methods/geo-ai-visibility-8weeks/): An 8-week GEO case raising AI mention rate from 1.7% to 35%.
- [GEO 效果里的三个假象](https://www.huanworks.com/methods/geo-verification-traps/): Three illusions in GEO measurement: ranking first for yourself may be fake.
- [数据 → 洞察 → 行动 → 结果：增长复盘闭环](https://www.huanworks.com/methods/growth-data-action-loop/): The data-insight-action-result growth review loop.
- [小红书新品打爆 KFS 框架](https://www.huanworks.com/methods/kfs-new-product-launch-framework/): KFS framework for launching new products on Xiaohongshu, from insight to roadmap.
- [本地 LLM 任务路由](https://www.huanworks.com/methods/local-llm-task-routing/): Choosing between local LLMs on privacy, cost, speed and quality.
- [元元提示法笔记](https://www.huanworks.com/methods/meta-meta-prompting/): Notes on the meta-prompting method for running AI agents.
- [n8n × Obsidian 工作流边界](https://www.huanworks.com/methods/n8n-obsidian-workflow-boundaries/): Orchestration is not a source of facts: boundaries for n8n and Obsidian workflows.
- [RAG 知识库四道质量门](https://www.huanworks.com/methods/rag-knowledge-quality-gates/): Govern first, then retrieve: four quality gates for RAG knowledge bases.
- [AI 产品化的“微信入口模式”](https://www.huanworks.com/methods/wechat-ai-product-entry-mode/): Selling services, not tools, through a WeChat entry point.
- [小红书千帆推广排障框架](https://www.huanworks.com/methods/xiaohongshu-qianfan-ecommerce-diagnosis/): Troubleshooting Qianfan campaigns from plan goals to product and landing pages.
- [小红书搜索首屏三要素](https://www.huanworks.com/methods/xiaohongshu-search-firstscreen/): First-screen search: buy the right keywords, say the right things, bid the right prices.
- [小红书小红盟意向人群](https://www.huanworks.com/methods/xiaohongshu-xiaohongmeng-intent-audience/): Intent audiences: pre-launch insight, in-flight targeting, post-flight review.
